title: [DEPLOY-QUEUE][READY] Hermes Deals origin path read-only canary
body:
## Queue contract

- **source_repository:** `rozkalnsandris/hermes-deals`
- **exact_git_sha_or_waiting_merge:** `fbe3cfa143788607446d0095ae1f887354d10eb3`
- **source_pr_or_issue_if_applicable:** Hermes Deals #384 canary source fixture only
- **target_alias:** `hermes-deals-origin-path-audit`
- **execution_location_class:** `trusted-home-host`
- **repository_entrypoint:** `tools/runner/origin-path-rpi5-audit-dispatcher.sh` fixed reviewed selector
- **expected_baseline_when_observable:** resolve the root-owned origin-path registration immediately before dispatch
- **read_only_preflight:** exact repository identity, merged/reachable SHA, exact-SHA CI, workflow/helper identities and registration
- **verification_and_reconciliation:** sanitized manifest must bind authorized SHA/as-of and all production mutation flags remain false
- **allowed_mutation_categories_and_limits:** one read-only audit invocation; zero production mutations
- **explicit_exclusions:** production DB; deploy/cutover; restart/config; parser/collector; runner changes; credentials/permissions
- **dependencies_if_any:** #787 migration contract plus audited workflow/dispatcher/installer/probe source identities
- **deploy_class_and_extra_owner_gate_requirement:** `STRICT_LIVE_AUTH_REQUIRED`; deferred pull remains separately owner-authorized

## Evidence

Source-only canary fixture. It does not create LIVE-AUTH, activate the executor, install a broker, or replace the current self-hosted audit path.
